), a leading provider of telecom and broadband equipment, today announced its fully standards-compliant 50G PON product portfolio, designed to meet rapidly growing bandwidth demands and accelerate the evolution toward all-fiber networks. While enabling high-capacity, multi-gigabit symmetrical connectivity, the solution provides a scalable foundation for new residential, business, and mobile services while helping service providers optimize network capacity and unlock new service opportunities.

"Growing bandwidth demands are accelerating the shift toward higher-capacity, all-fiber networks, with 50G PON emerging as a key technology for next-generation broadband," said Dan Whalen, Chief Commercial Officer of Sercomm. "We are developing our 50G PON CPE portfolio to help service providers to navigate the transition to fiber in residential, enterprise, mobile backhaul and cable broadband markets with greater flexibility and confidence. Leveraging our long-standing expertise in fiber gateway development, Sercomm delivers interoperable and scalable 50G PON solutions designed to integrate seamlessly into evolving network architectures."

Driven by increasing demand for 8K streaming, cloud gaming, AR/VR, enterprise connectivity and mobile backhaul, 50G PON has emerged as the next evolution beyond XGS-PON. Sercomm's 50G PON ONU lineup follows ITU-T G.9804.3 specifications, supporting both asymmetric 50G/25G and symmetrical 50G/50G operation. The solution supports tri-PON coexistence with GPON and XGS-PON over the same optical distribution network (ODN), protecting operators' existing fiber investments and supporting a phased migration from HFC to fiber-deep architectures.

Sercomm's 50G PON ecosystem includes high-performance residential gateways and SFP pluggable ONUs, incorporating optimized DBA, enhanced OAM and network slicing capabilities to support DPoE deployment models for multiple broadband deployment scenarios, including cable, fiber and converged access networks. Combined with Sercomm's upcoming Wi‑Fi 8 gateway solutions, the platform delivers end-to-end multi-gigabit connectivity and creates opportunities for new high-value residential and commercial services.

Sercomm will showcase its 50G PON solution at SCTE TechExpo26, taking place September 29–October 1, 2026, at the Georgia World Congress Center in Atlanta, Georgia. Visit Sercomm Booth No. I1638 to discover fiber migration strategies, customized solutions, and interoperability capabilities. For more information about Sercomm's 50G PON solution, please visit https://www.sercomm.com/en/solutions/product/6/0/19.
